title: Generated content: math, inline citation chips and source list
description: Render model Markdown safely with GFM and KaTeX math, turn [source:UUID] markers into inline page chips scoped to the message's citations, and deduplicate sources by page.
acceptance_criteria: Given content with \(x^2\) and \[E=mc^2\], then inline and display math render; '$5 and $10' stays plain text.
Given a [source:UUID] marker matching a citation, then a 'p. N' chip renders at that position; unknown or other-document markers render nothing.
Given duplicate citations on one page, then the source list shows that page once; raw HTML, images and javascript: links remain inert.
verification: Content agent, test-first. Red: math.test and remark-citations.test failed on unresolved modules; component tests 16 failed / 25 passed against the lead's stubs (missing 'Source, page 7' button, math, table and the Sources group). After implementation, 2 failed with a jsdom MathML style TypeError; tests now query math with hidden:true. Visual round 1 found duplicate same-page chips, chip contrast about 4.35:1, lost dialog focus and HoverCard passive-listener errors on touch; each got a red test and a fix. Agent check: 72 tests. Lead integration after merge: npm run check 32 files/147 tests, build main 393.46KB. KaTeX CSS and JS are only in lazy chunks. Follow-up in progress (test-first): newline-preserving display math, indented code blocks, link destinations. Follow-up: TDD audit by the agent (7 component tests were never red because the stubs already behaved; math/plugin reds were missing-module only). 0ac0d3f adds test-after coverage with mutation checks, and 2 vacuous tests were found and fixed. Math edge cases were done test-first, 7 failed before implementation: multi-line display math keeps lines (KaTeX % comment had swallowed '+ 2'), indented code skipped, link destinations/autolinks skipped. Lead integration: 178 tests in 3 consecutive full runs. Remaining known gaps (accepted): display math in table cells/headings stays inline, markers in link text dropped, indented code inside blockquotes/6-space list code, reference definitions, multi-line inline \\( \\).
